title: Campaign Config
description: Campaign settings, including the Session Zero agreements. Checklist Section 6: write these down and keep them.

source_books_allowed.description: Checklist 6.3: state the source books you allow.

planned_length_sessions.description: Checklist 1.4: a first campaign must have 6 to 10 sessions.

character_death_policy.description: Checklist 6.4: how death is handled at this table.
examples: Standard 5e death saves, no permadeath without player agreement
Permadeath, character retires and a new one joins next session

safety_limits.description: Checklist 6.5: hard limits and soft limits.

hard_limits.description: Topics that must not appear at all.

soft_limits.description: Topics that may appear only with care.

table_rules.description: Checklist 6.6-6.7. Not applicable to a solo, asynchronous campaign — leave empty and note why in campaign notes.

party_backstory.description: Checklist 6.8: how the player characters know each other. Do not start session 1 with strangers in a tavern.
